'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 missile explosion in Poland]]
****[[Germany]] offers to deploy its [[German Air Force|Air Force]] jets to protect [[Poland|Polish]] [[airspace]] in response to Tuesday's [[missile]] [[explosion]] in [[Przewodów]], [[Lublin Voivodeship]], that killed two people. [https://www.anews.com.tr/world/2022/11/16/germany-offers-to-send-combat-jets-to-poland (A News)]
***[[October–November 2022 nationwide missile strikes on Ukraine]]
****[[Russia]] carries out another wave of [[cruise missile]] strikes on [[Ukraine]], with strikes reported in [[Dnipro]], [[Odesa]], [[Kharkiv]], and [[Zaporizhzhia]], where two people were confirmed to have been killed overnight by a missile. In Dnipro and Odesa, [[critical infrastructure]] is also targeted. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/nov/17/russia-ukraine-war-live-news-blasts-heard-in-crimea-putin-trying-to-freeze-ukraine-into-submission-us-envoy-says (''The Guardian'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[23rd Annual Latin Grammy Awards]]
**The 23rd Annual [[Latin Grammy Awards]] are held at the [[Michelob Ultra Arena]] in Las Vegas, Nevada. Uruguayan singer-songwriter [[Jorge Drexler]]  was the most awarded artist with six wins. [https://www.billboard.com/music/latin/latin-grammys-2022-winners-list-1235172910/ (''Billboard'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[November 2022 United Kingdom autumn statement]]
***[[Chancellor of the Exchequer]] [[Jeremy Hunt]] delivers the delayed autumn statement to [[parliament of the United Kingdom|parliament]], announcing measures to stabilize the [[Economy of the United Kingdom|economy]] amid a [[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis|cost of living crisis]], including raising the [[National Living Wage]] from [[pound sterling|£]]9.50 an hour to £10.42 beginning next year, increasing pensions and [[Welfare state in the United Kingdom|welfare]] payments in line with rising [[inflation]], introducing a higher rate [[windfall tax]] on the profits of energy firms, introducing a new "temporary tax" on companies that generate electricity, and capping rent increases in the social sector to 7% until 2024. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-63591754 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Jabalia fire]]
**At least 21 people are killed in a fire at a [[Residential area|residential building]] in [[Jabalia]], [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/at-least-21-people-including-7-children-killed-in-residential-home-fire-in-gaza/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*Fifteen people are killed and 16 more injured by an explosion caused by a [[gas leak]] at a residential building in [[Sulaymaniyah]], [[Kurdistan Region]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/18/gas-cylinder-explosion-in-iraq-kills (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Mali relations]], [[Mali War]]
**The [[Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (France)|French foreign ministry]] announces the temporary suspension of [[development aid]] to [[Mali]], citing the controversial relationship between the [[Assimi Goïta]]-led [[military junta]] and [[Russia]]'s [[Wagner Group]] in the war. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20221119-france-halts-development-aid-to-mali-over-wagner-russia-paramilitaries (AFP via RFI)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Malaysia Airlines Flight 17]]
**A court in the [[Netherlands]] sentences two [[Russians]], [[Igor Girkin|Igor Strelkov-Girkin]] and Sergey Dubinsky, and a Ukrainian [[Russian people's militias in Ukraine|pro-Russian separatist]] Leonid Kharchenko to [[life imprisonment]] for [[list of aircraft shootdowns|shooting down]] the [[Malaysia Airlines]] flight over [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]] in 2014. The verdict was delivered ''[[Trial in absentia|in absentia]]'' of the [[defendant]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-business-kuala-lumpur-malaysia-netherlands-099084a82b49b77b116878e24fc63a18 (AP)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[State Administration Council]] of [[Myanmar]] grants an [[amnesty]] to 5,774 prisoners, including former [[List of ambassadors of the United Kingdom to Myanmar|British ambassador]] [[Vicky Bowman]] and Australian [[economist]] [[Sean Turnell]], a former economic policy advisor to jailed [[State Counsellor of Myanmar|state counsellor]] [[Aung San Suu Kyi]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20221117-myanmar-s-junta-to-release-700-prisoners-including-a-former-british-ambassador (AFP via France 24)]
